title: Average on a coset
statement: Let $H$ be a subspace of the binary cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, let a binary subspace split of $H$ be given, let $f$ map the binary cube to the signs, and let $a$ be a point of the complementary binary cube specified by the split. The coset average at $a$ is the average, over uniformly chosen $h\in H$, of the real sign value of $f$ evaluated at the point determined by $h$ and $a$ under the split.
